candidate_relations.reason: The reference is the composite diagnosis of benign-appearing LPD with endometriosis. Leiomyosarcoma asserts an incompatible malignant subtype and omits both the disseminated peritoneal pattern and the endometriosis component; the low Ki-67 index also does not support leiomyosarcoma.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Malignant pelvic smooth-muscle tumor rather than disseminated peritoneal leiomyomatosis with endometriosis.
